messages.name: CheckFee
messages.docs:
Tag 0: refuse (27) unless `fee` is the configured rate's fee on `total` and, when `fee > 0`, `treasury` is
the configured treasury. Writes nothing. Accepted from anyone, only at the config actor, in every config
state: an empty config (before `Init`) reads as rate 0, and it keeps working after `Renounce`.

fields.name: total
fields.docs: The schedule total, or the sum of item totals of a batch.

fields.name: treasury
fields.docs: The treasury named by the creation message (the owner of the fee destination).

fields.name: asset
fields.docs: The asset the fee is paid in. Version 1 applies one rate to every asset.

messages.name: SetFee
messages.docs: Tag 1: set the rate and treasury; admin only. Refuses a rate above [`MAX_FEE_BPS`] (28).

fields.name: rate_bps
fields.docs: The new rate in basis points.

fields.name: nominee
fields.docs: The account the holder nominated, until it accepts or the offer changes.

fields.name: old_rate_bps
fields.docs: The rate before, in basis points.

fields.name: new_rate_bps
fields.docs: The rate after, in basis points.

fields.name: treasury
fields.docs: The treasury: the owner of the fee destination (SPEC 6).

fields.name: admin
fields.docs: The admin slot of the RFP-001 admin authority.

fields.name: via
fields.docs: The program the holder acts through, or `None` for top level.

errors.name: FeeMismatch
errors.msg: the creation fee does not match the current rate or treasury

errors.name: FeeAboveCap
errors.msg: the fee rate exceeds the hard cap
